data.one_liner: A customizable date and time picker supporting multiple languages.
data.what_it_does: Provides date, time, and combined date-time pickers via method calls. Supports custom picker models, multiple languages, and mouse drag and wheel interactions on web and desktop.
use_when: You need a date or time picker that supports multiple languages out-of-the-box.
You want to customize the picker content or layout structure using custom picker models.
You need to replace the default title bar with custom widgets using a builder.
avoid_when: You are using a version of Flutter older than 3.47.0 (for version 3.x).
You prefer built-in declarative Material or Cupertino date pickers.
strengths: Supports a wide array of languages and internationalization.
Highly customizable via CommonPickerModel and custom title bar builders.
Provides mouse and scroll wheel support for web and desktop platforms.
weaknesses: Requires standalone material_ui and cupertino_ui packages on recent Flutter versions.
